Rate each: vorhanden / teilweise / fehlt.

1. Directory Verification:

   - Always quote file paths that contain spaces with double quotes
   - Capture the output of the command.

   - Escape character is backtick (`), not backslash
   - Use Verb-Noun cmdlet naming: Get-ChildItem, Set-Location, New-Item, Remove-Item
   - Common aliases: ls (Get-ChildItem), cd (Set-Location), cat (Get-Content), rm (Remove-Item)
   - Pipe operator | works similarly to bash but passes objects, not text
   - Use Select-Object, Where-Object, ForEach-Object for filtering and transformation
   - String interpolation: "Hello $name" or "Hello $($obj.Property)"
   - Registry access uses PSDrive prefixes: `HKLM:\SOFTWARE\...`, `HKCU:\...` — NOT raw `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\...`
   - Environment variables: read with `$env:NAME`, set with `$env:NAME = "value"` (NOT `Set-Variable` or bash `export`)

    - Read files: Use Read (NOT Get-Content)

    - Communication: Output text directly (NOT Write-Output/Write-Host)

import PortalRahmen from "@/components/Portal/PortalRahmen";
import { portalNutzer } from "@/lib/plattform/server/seite";
import { backend, istDemo } from "@/lib/plattform/backend";
import { nutzerFuerBrowser } from "@/lib/plattform/server/route";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata = {
  title: { template: "%s | Portal ÖkoInvest", default: "Portal | ÖkoInvest" },
  robots: { index: false, follow: false, nocache: true },
  // PWA des Portals (Bedienung & Onboarding): eigenes Manifest mit start_url /portal
  manifest: "/portal.webmanifest",
  icons: { icon: "/icon.svg", apple: "/apple-touch-icon.png" },
  appleWebApp: { capable: true, title: "ÖkoInvest", statusBarStyle: "default" },
};

export default async function PortalLayout({ children }) {
  const nutzer = await portalNutzer();
  const b = backend();
  const admin = nutzer.rollen?.includes("admin");
  // Zähler sind nicht kritisch – Fehler dürfen das Portal nicht blockieren
  const [threads, hinweise, aufgaben] = await Promise.all([
    b.nachrichtenThreads(nutzer).catch(() => []),
    b.benachrichtigungen(nutzer, { limit: 8 }).catch(() => ({ eintraege: [], ungelesen: 0 })),
    admin ? b.aufgaben(nutzer, { zustaendigId: nutzer.id, status: "offen" }).catch(() => []) : [],
  ]);
  const ungelesen = threads.reduce((s, t) => s + (t.ungelesen || 0), 0);
  const aufgabenFaellig = aufgaben.filter((a) => a.ueberfaellig || a.heuteFaellig).length;
  return (
    <PortalRahmen
      nutzer={nutzerFuerBrowser(nutzer)}
      ungelesen={ungelesen}
      hinweise={{ eintraege: hinweise.eintraege, ungelesen: hinweise.ungelesen }}
      aufgabenFaellig={aufgabenFaellig}
      demo={istDemo()}
    >
      {children}
    </PortalRahmen>
  );
}

## Findings: optional module "Projekt-KG investor financing" (repo C:/Users/SALEADMIN/Downloads/Oekoinvest-Web)

### A. Feature flag / module switch
**There is no generic module switch.** I searched for feature flag, module-active, settings toggles and env patterns and found none for modules. The only switches are single-purpose env variables:
- `KI_AUS` in `src/lib/plattform/ki/konfig.js`
- `PLATTFORM_KYC_GATING` (KYC gating, Compliance settings plus env; see `src/lib/plattform/backend/demo/kyc.js:754`)
- `PLATTFORM_2FA_PFLICHT`
- `PLATTFORM_BACKEND` / `PLATTFORM_DEMO` (backend choice, in `src/lib/plattform/backend/index.js`)

Frappe has Single settings doctypes, but none of them has a module on/off field: `kyc_einstellungen`, `plattform_finanzen_einstellungen`, `plattform_betrieb_einstellungen`, `plattform_energie_einstellungen`, `plattform_service_einstellungen`, `plattform_buchhaltung_einstellungen`.

**How visibility is decided today (by role and rights only):**
- **Portal menu:** `src/components/Portal/PortalRahmen.js` (756 lines), function `navigation(rollen, nutzer)` at line 55.
  - Customer items are filtered by role with `hat("investor")` etc. (lines 62–96).
  - Backoffice items are filtered by `darfLesen(nutzer, seitenBereich(href))` (line 136).
- **Rights:** `src/lib/plattform/rechte.js`
  - `BACKOFFICE_ROLLEN`: leitung, akquise, transaktion, buchhaltung, lesen, betrieb, compliance, projektleitung, energie, eg.
  - `BEREICHE`, plus the matrix `RECHTE_MATRIX`.
  - `SEITEN_BEREICH` maps pages to areas; `API_BEREICH` with `apiAnforderungen` maps APIs to areas.
- **User roles:** `src/lib/plattform/konstanten.js` (`ROLLEN`: flaeche, landwirt, investor, anbieter, unternehmen, mitglied, kommune; external roles gutachter, lieferant, bank).
- **Other places that link to pages and would also need hiding:**
  - `src/components/Portal/Bedienung/befehle.js` (command palette, about 60 links)
  - `BottomNav.js` and `SprungLinks.js` in `src/components/Portal/Bedienung/`
  - `src/lib/plattform/suche.js`
  - EG keeps its own page list in `src/lib/plattform/eg/navigation.js` (`EG_SEITEN`), a pattern worth copying.
- **API:** every route goes through `route()` in `src/lib/plattform/server/route.js:130` (auth, roles, `adminRechtPruefen`). That is the natural central place for a module check returning 404.
- **Page guard:** `portalNutzer()` in `src/lib/plattform/server/seite.js`.
- **Middleware:** `src/middleware.js` only checks the session for `/portal/**` and `/api/portal/**`.
- **Public site:**
  - Static links in `src/components/Navbar/navbar.js`.
  - Projektbörse: `src/app/projektboerse/**` and `src/app/api/boerse/**`, using the projections in `src/lib/plattform/oeffentlich.js` (public vs. confidential field lists).
  - `src/app/sitemap.js`.
  - Nothing on the public site is conditional on a module.

**Conclusion:** a module flag must be newly built and checked in every place above: PortalRahmen, befehle, BottomNav, suche, `route()`, page guards, the Börse projection, navbar/sitemap, plus Frappe API whitelist and Desk workspace.

### B. What already exists per area
Paths below are relative to `Backend-Import/oekoinvest_app/oekoinvest_app/plattform/` for Python and doctypes (DT), and to `src/lib/plattform/` for JS unless written in full.

Backoffice page `/portal/admin/gesellschaften` (area `gesellschaften`), from the Dienste module (`backend/dienste.js`, `demo/dienste.js`, `frappe/dienste.js`).
